objective: Test whether strong 1H/H4 side-specific adverse-excursion ranking can improve the existing 12Min/H12 Ridge expected-move opportunity policy as a veto-only slow-risk context.
timestamp_contract: Use the corrected deep timestamp contract. A 1H risk score is available only at the end of its fully completed hour; every 12Min decision joins the latest risk score with available_at <= decision timestamp.

opportunity_policy.model: StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=10.0) on normalized future point move
opportunity_policy.signal_rule: Trade sign(predicted normalized move) only when abs(prediction) clears the fixed 50th-percentile threshold learned from four chronological inner OOF folds using prior data only.
opportunity_policy.authority: Proposal/control only; no tuning in this experiment.

risk_policy.model: Side-specific HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=quantile, quantile=0.80, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=180, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=42)
risk_policy.threshold: For each outer period and side, q80 of that fitted risk model's predictions on prior training rows only. No economic outcome selects the threshold.

consumer_rule: Start from each baseline Ridge expected-move signal. For a long signal, abstain only if the latest completed-hour predicted long MAE is >= its prior-training q80 threshold. For a short signal, use predicted short MAE analogously. Otherwise preserve the Ridge direction exactly. Risk context may veto only; it cannot invert direction, create trades, resize, or change the Ridge magnitude gate.

chronology.discovery_panel: Quarterly expanding walk-forward from 2023Q3 through 2025Q4. Both 12Min opportunity and 1H risk models are trained only on data strictly prior to the evaluation period with their own horizon purges.
chronology.forward_panel: Freeze the same composite policy and evaluate corrected 2026-01-01 onward data with no changes after discovery outcomes.
forbidden: retune q50 Ridge magnitude threshold from economic outcomes
retune q80 MAE veto threshold from economic outcomes
select long/short thresholds separately after outcomes
use NQ as a model input

economics.phase_rule: Every absolute-UTC non-overlap H12 phase is reported; none selected post-hoc.
required_metrics: baseline and conditioned weekly median phase net points
cumulative weekly points and max drawdown

discovery_advance_rule: At both 1pt and 2pt costs require at least 80 paired valid weeks, positive paired median delta, positive paired mean delta, paired win fraction >0.50, conditioned positive-week fraction >= baseline, conditioned p10 >= baseline, conditioned bottom-decile mean >= baseline, and conditioned max drawdown no worse than baseline. All checks must pass.
forward_confirmation_rule: The corrected 2026 panel is low-power confirmation only. Require positive paired median and mean delta and wins in a majority of available paired weeks to continue. A pass cannot promote trading; a failure rejects or redesigns the consumer.
interpretation: Because both components were discovered on overlapping historical MNQ data before this composite was proposed, even a discovery-panel pass is exploratory. A composite that also survives frozen 2026 confirmation may advance to independent NQ/pre-2019 mechanism validation and additional untouched/paper-forward observation, not trading authority.
nq_boundary: NQ is excluded from model inputs and threshold fitting. It is reserved for later independent/pre-MNQ validation of an unchanged composite mechanism if this MNQ consumer survives.
